title: Process reference pack per module
requirement: Before the first slice of each module (the business masters, supplier management, catalogue, requests, orders, receiving, invoicing, contracts, the supplier portal surface, and every later product), a process reference pack shall exist and be approved: APQC PCF activity mapping, process maps (BPMN) for the main flow and each variant and exception, standards mapping (section 2.1), benchmark indicators with targets, competitive feature review of leading suites and networks, open gaps, and a research log with sources and dates.
rationale: Decision F-17: not limited by what we know today.
acceptance_criteria: Given a module slice is scheduled, When the design review runs, Then the pack is present and approved, or the slice is blocked.|Given a pack, When reviewed, Then every requirement of the module maps to a PCF activity and a process map step, or an exclusion is recorded.|Given a pack without the competitive review, When submitted for approval, Then it is refused. (error case)
notes: Was FF-200. The list of modules follows the split: the method binds the business masters and every product (ADR-0041).

title: External practitioner review
requirement: Each process reference pack and each module design shall be reviewed by at least one external practitioner with recent experience of a leading suite or network; review findings shall be recorded with disposition (accepted, deferred, rejected with reason) before the first slice of the module starts.
rationale: Independent challenge of the team's assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a review completed, When the module slice starts, Then the findings and dispositions are recorded.|Given a module without a review record, When the slice is scheduled, Then it is blocked. (error case)|Given a deferred finding, When the next version is planned, Then it appears in the backlog with its source.

title: Research log and living process documentation
requirement: The research log (sources, dates, findings, decisions) and the process maps shall be kept with the products' documentation, updated with each release that changes a process, and published to customers as process documentation per module.
acceptance_criteria: Given a release that changes a process, When published, Then the process map version matches the release.|Given a customer administrator, When they open process documentation, Then the current maps and variants are shown.|Given a process change merged without a documentation update, When the release checklist runs, Then it is blocked. (error case)

title: Standards alignment of document models
requirement: The data models of orders, order responses, shipment notices, receipts, invoices and credit notes shall be mapped field by field to UBL 2.1 and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (and UN/CEFACT where relevant); mandatory fields of the standards shall exist in the model or be recorded as exclusions with reasons; exports in UBL shall be possible for invoices and orders in a later slice.
acceptance_criteria: Given the invoice model, When compared with Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, Then every mandatory element has a field or a recorded exclusion.|Given an order, When exported as UBL (later slice), Then it validates against the schema.|Given a new field added to the invoice model, When the standards mapping is not updated, Then the review is blocked. (error case)

title: Benchmark indicators built in
requirement: The products shall compute the benchmark indicators from the research basis (first-pass match rate, invoice cycle time, order cycle time, acknowledgement time, catalogue and contract compliance, cost per order inputs, supplier on-time delivery, electronic invoice share) with the same definitions as the reference sources so that customers can compare with industry benchmarks.
rationale: Customers judge the products by these numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quarter of data, When indicators compute, Then each shows value, definition and the reference it follows.|Given a definition changed in a later version, When computed, Then both the old and new values are available for the transition period. (edge)|Given insufficient data, When computed, Then the indicator shows "insufficient data" with the minimum needed. (error case)
notes: Was FF-203. "The product" became the products.
